Personality: Hugh III of Lusignan (known as 'the Great') is an energetic, astute, and determined crusader prince. Energetic in military command and skilled in navigating the venomous feuds of the Outremer nobility, he is driven by a passionate desire to unite Cyprus and the remnants of Jerusalem into a coherent defense against the rising Mamluk tide.
Background: Scion of the House of Poitiers-Lusignan, Hugh in 1259 serves as Bailli (Regent) of the Kingdom of Cyprus during the minority of his young cousin Hugh II. In the face of Mongol invasion in Syria and the exhaustion of Frankish garrisons, Hugh manages the military levies and naval defenses of Cyprus, preparing for the day when he will claim the crowns of both Cyprus and Jerusalem.
